name: PT Perusahaan Perkebunan London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Perusahaan Perkebunan London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the plantation business in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Oil Palm Products, Seeds, and Others. It offers crude palm oil, palm kernel oil, rubber, cocoa, tea, and oil palm seeds. The company also operates palm oil mills, crumb rubber processing facilities, sheet rubber processing facilities, cocoa factories, and tea factories.
